/audio/mycorner/kokoro-heart/mycorner-01.speechText: chrysalis. Definition: The stage in which a caterpillar transforms into a butterfly. In this passage, Alice imagines the Caterpillar becoming a chrysalis.
contemptuously. Definition: In a way that shows scorn or disrespect. In this passage, the Caterpillar contemptuously repeats his question.
gravely. Definition: In a serious, solemn manner. In this passage, Alice gravely asks the Caterpillar to identify himself.

/audio/mycorner/kokoro-heart/mycorner-02.speechText: guile. Definition: Clever dishonesty used to hide the truth. In this passage, the mask is a form of human guile.
over-wise. Definition: Too eager to know or examine what other people conceal. In this passage, overwise describes a world that examines every hidden sorrow.
tortured. Definition: Experiencing severe physical or emotional pain. In this passage, tortured souls hide their suffering behind smiles.

/audio/mycorner/kokoro-heart/mycorner-03.speechText: doff. Definition: Take off or cast aside. In this passage, Juliet asks Romeo to doff his family name.
counsel. Definition: Private thoughts or deliberations. In this passage, Romeo overhears Juliet’s private counsel.
utterance. Definition: The act or sound of speaking. In this passage, Juliet recognizes Romeo by his utterance.

/audio/mycorner/kokoro-heart/mycorner-04.speechText: imitation. Definition: An attempt to copy someone or something. In this passage, the doctor calls the supposed English accent a poor imitation.
impostor. Definition: Someone pretending to be another person. In this passage, the doctor calls the supposed uncle an impostor.
receipt. Definition: A written acknowledgment that money was received. In this passage, Mary Jane hands over money without asking for a receipt.

/audio/mycorner/kokoro-heart/mycorner-05.speechText: contemplated. Definition: Looked at or considered carefully. In this passage, the emperor pretends he contemplated his new clothes.
mantle. Definition: A loose outer cloak. In this passage, the attendants pretend to lift the emperor’s mantle.
incomparable. Definition: So exceptional that nothing else can match it. In this passage, the crowd calls the unseen clothes incomparable.

/audio/mycorner/kokoro-heart/mycorner-06.speechText: guardian. Definition: A person responsible for another person's care. In this passage, Jack says a guardian must set a moral example.
conduce. Definition: Help to bring about a result. In this passage, Jack doubts that a high moral tone will conduce to happiness.
forte. Definition: A person's particular strength or skill. In this passage, Algernon says literary criticism is not Jack’s forte.

/audio/mycorner/kokoro-heart/mycorner-07.speechText: scrawled. Definition: Wrote hastily or untidily. In this passage, the king scrawled a sample for the lawyer.
astonished. Definition: Greatly surprised. In this passage, the lawyer is astonished by the unclear handwriting.
resemblance. Definition: Similarity in appearance or form. In this passage, the old letters show a stronger resemblance than the lawyer noticed.

/audio/mycorner/kokoro-heart/mycorner-08.speechText: banish. Definition: Send someone away or exclude them. In this passage, the speaker jokes that others would banish the pair.
dreary. Definition: Dull, tiresome, or depressing. In this passage, the speaker finds public importance dreary.
bog. Definition: An area of wet, spongy ground. In this passage, the frog announces itself to an admiring bog.

/audio/mycorner/kokoro-heart/mycorner-09.speechText: tactics. Definition: Methods used to achieve a particular aim. In this passage, scammers use tactics designed to make a false emergency convincing.
clone. Definition: Make a close copy of something. In this passage, a scammer can clone a familiar voice from a recording.
verify. Definition: Check whether something is true or genuine. In this passage, a known phone number helps you verify the caller’s story.
